newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight money steady in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight money steady in liquid market.

text.p: Manila overnight money held firm at an average of 10.03125 percent on Monday despite the covering of three days of weekend positions, dealers said.
"The market remains liquid," a dealer said.
Rates were locked from 10.25 to 10.03125 percent, with 25 lenders and 23 borrowers.
The Central Bank continued to keep a floor on rates through its overnight borrowing rate of 10 percent.
In the secondary market for T-bills, there was little activity ahead of the Treasury bill rate auction today.
The market was swamped with sellers but there were few buyers, traders said.
"They're (the banks) waiting for the rates to go up," a big bank dealer said.
Interest rates are expected to rally at the T-bill auction today after reaching very low levels. Dealers said the benchmark 91-day T-bill rate may hit ten percent from last week's 9.583 percent.
